test_cases.title: Registered user receives time-limited reset link
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user receives a time-limited password reset link via email.

steps.action: A registered user enters their email address in the password reset form and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system generates a time-limited reset link and sends it to the user's email address within 5 seconds of submission, with a clear expiration time (e.g., 15 minutes).

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Unregistered user receives same confirmation as registered user
test_cases.objective: Verify that unregistered users receive the same confirmation message as registered users during password reset.

steps.action: An unregistered user enters an email address in the password reset form and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system displays the same confirmation message as for registered users — e.g., 'A reset link has been sent to your email' — and sends a reset link regardless of registration status.

source_requirements: The same confirmation is shown for registered and unregistered emails.

test_cases.title: New password satisfies password policy
test_cases.objective: Verify that the new password meets the defined password policy when resetting.

steps.action: A user clicks the reset link, enters a new password that satisfies the password policy (e.g., at least 8 characters, one uppercase, one number), and submits it.
steps.expected_result: The system accepts the password and updates the user's account with the new password, with a success message displayed.

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the password policy.

test_cases.title: Invalid password policy violation is rejected
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system rejects a password that does not meet the password policy.

steps.action: A user attempts to reset their password with a password that violates the policy (e.g., 6 characters, no numbers or uppercase letters).
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the password does not meet the policy requirements and does not allow the password to be saved.

source_requirements: The new password must satisfy the password policy.

test_cases.title: Password reset link expires after time limit
test_cases.objective: Verify that the password reset link expires after the time limit and no longer functions after expiration.

steps.action: A user receives a password reset link with a 15-minute expiration time and attempts to use it after 16 minutes have passed.
steps.expected_result: The system rejects the reset request with a message indicating the link has expired and cannot be used.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.

test_cases.title: Invalid email format is handled gracefully
test_cases.objective: Verify that the system handles a malformed or invalid email address during password reset.

steps.action: A user submits an email address with invalid format (e.g., 'invalid-email') in the password reset form.
steps.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the email is invalid and does not proceed to generate a reset link.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.
